author: Chris Cooley
name: Byte Runner
tagline: Eat the page. Flip the chase.
description: Read between the lines, then eat them. Collect letters, catch an overclock orb, and turn the ghosts chasing you into points.
controls: P — pause · G — next gate · Esc — Recall

chapters.title: The text is the trail.
chapters.body: The runner turns nearby letters into points and literal 0/1 characters in the existing DOM Text nodes. Movement is sampled every seven pixels so a slow frame does not skip a line of food; at most six fresh letters are consumed per update. Spent digits remain visible but cannot be eaten twice. Recall restores still-owned text.

chapters.title: Overclock reverses the rules.
chapters.body: Every sixth fresh letter places an orb near the player. Collect it for six seconds of power, stacking up to nine seconds. Fruit starts appearing after fourteen seconds, then every eighteen. While powered, factories pause their spawning and ghosts flee. Collect the power-up itself; eating six letters alone does not activate it.

chapters.title: Three approaches to pursuit.
chapters.body: Some ghosts chase your current position. Another kind aims sixty pixels ahead in your direction of travel. Speed grows with time-based waves, capped at 205 pixels per second. Ghost silhouettes and the runner’s opening jaw use small canvas paths; their animation follows the simulation clock.

chapters.title: Small, finite, reusable.
chapters.body: A shared entity pool caps ghosts at forty and uncollected pickups at four. Expired pickups and removed ghosts return their storage for reuse. Keyboard movement selects the most recently pressed axis when directions conflict, keeping the classic four-direction chase feel.

extra: Three lives. Waves advance every twenty-two seconds. A powered ghost chain awards 100, 200, 300, then 400 points per ghost; spawning resumes after power expires.

characters.name: Byte Runner
characters.rules: Move with arrows or the touch D-pad. Eat letters into real 0s and 1s. Every sixth letter drops a power orb.

characters.name: Chaser
characters.rules: The violet ghost heads toward your current position. Without power, contact costs a life.

characters.name: Interceptor
characters.rules: The pink ghost aims ahead of your heading. Turn to change its interception point.

characters.name: Sprinter
characters.rules: The cyan ghost follows directly at a higher speed. All ghosts speed up as waves rise.

characters.name: Vulnerable ghosts
characters.rules: Eat an orb or fruit to seal the gates temporarily. Ghosts turn blue, flee and become edible. Chain catches for increasing points.
